compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
After Gerrit 1796, `src/rebar/llm/completion.py` sits at 800 LOC (the absolute CI module-size cap) and `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py` at 799. Any edit to either must extract first or the module-size gate fails. Each module carries several distinct concerns. Operator direction: remediate BOTH architecturally — separate concerns into modules with clear contractual boundaries, not a mechanical split to duck under the cap.

## Concern map (from the real call graph, verified by Serena refs + grep string sweep)
`completion.py` (800) holds four concerns: (1) operation orchestration — `verify_completion`/`_verify_completion_inner`/`_verifier_model_for_completion`/`verify_step_floor` (consumers: `src/rebar/llm/__init__.py:38`, `workflow/completion_banking.py:38`, `workflow/gate_dispatch.py`); (2) deterministic child-closure gate — `child_closure_findings`/`_uncertified_child_ids`/`build_child_closure_evidence` (consumer: `workflow/gate_ops.py:61,224`); (3) epic-close bug-screen deterministic layer — `EPIC_BUG_SCREEN_CEILING`, `_epic_subtree_states`, `_open_bugs`, `_first_in_progress_ns`, `epic_bug_floor_findings`, `epic_bug_candidates` (consumers: `gate_ops.py:64`, `epic_bug_screen.py:267-275`, whose docstring already describes these as the screen's DET stages 1-2); (4) verdict reconciliation — remediation constants, `reconcile_verdict` + fault/insufficiency helpers, `deterministic_child_failure`.
`completion_recovery.py` (799) holds three: (5) criteria surface + admission bounds + coverage contract — `explicit_completion_criteria`, `physical_context_ceiling`, `_validate_recovery_inputs`, `_validate_coverage`, the checkbox regexes and `_MAX_*` bounds; (6) failure taxonomy — `_normalized_finish_reason`, `_is_token_exhaustion`, `_bounded_diagnostic`, `raise_completion_workflow_failure`; (7) recovery orchestration — `CompletionAgentStep` (primary run + banked successors + finalization).

## Approach — target modules and their contracts
Behavior-preserving moves along the existing seams above; no signature or logic changes. Keep documented public seams stable via re-export; move internal consumers to the new homes.
- `rebar/llm/completion.py` (~250 LOC): OWNS the completion-verification operation (entry `verify_completion`, model/budget tuning `verify_step_floor`/`_VERIFY_STEP_FLOOR_MAX`/`_verifier_model_for_completion`) and REMAINS the stable public seam its `__all__` documents: re-exports `child_closure_findings`, `build_child_closure_evidence`, `deterministic_child_failure`, `reconcile_verdict`, `COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE`, and `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_REMEDIATION` (imported by name at `tests/unit/workflow/test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py:315`) — so `gate_ops` imports and `monkeypatch` strings on `rebar.llm.completion.*` (e.g. `tests/unit/test_ticket_description_limit.py:209`) stay valid unchanged.
- NEW `rebar/llm/completion_child_gate.py` (~210): OWNS the deterministic child-closure invariant + evidence block (concern 2). Exposes `child_closure_findings`, `build_child_closure_evidence`.
- NEW `rebar/llm/completion_reconcile.py` (~290): OWNS verdict normalization + remediation (concern 4): `reconcile_verdict`, `_findings_from_criteria`, `_is_no_verdict_fault`, `_insufficiency_only`, `NO_VERDICT_CRITERION`, both remediation constants, and `deterministic_child_failure` (the no-LLM FAIL verdict).
- `rebar/llm/epic_bug_screen.py` (297 → ~460): ABSORBS concern 3 so the entire epic bug screen (DET floor, DET candidate filter, LLM screen) is one module; `gate_ops.py:64` and `epic_bug_screen.py:267-275` switch to local/`epic_bug_screen` imports. The epic_bug_* symbols are NOT re-exported from completion.py, so EVERY `completion.epic_bug_*` reader in `tests/unit/test_epic_bug_screen_4b54.py` repoints to `epic_bug_screen`: direct attribute-call sites at lines 79, 94, 103, 112, 120, 129, 136, 238 AND monkeypatch targets at 230 (`EPIC_BUG_SCREEN_CEILING`) and 450 (`epic_bug_floor_findings`) — import/alias switch only.
- NEW `rebar/llm/workflow/completion_criteria.py` (~240): OWNS concern 5 — what counts as a completion criterion, the recovery admission bounds, and the full-coverage contract.
- NEW `rebar/llm/workflow/completion_failures.py` (~230): OWNS concern 6 — typed exhaustion classification, bounded allowlisted diagnostics, and workflow-failure finalization.
- `rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py` (~420): keeps `CompletionAgentStep` + finalizer constants; re-exports `explicit_completion_criteria`, `raise_completion_workflow_failure` (its documented `__all__`) AND `physical_context_ceiling` — so `gate_dispatch.py:669`, `completion_prefetch.py:214`, the patch string `test_completion_prefetch.py:120`, and every `_cr.physical_context_ceiling` module-alias read (`test_close_gate_bound_remedy_db1c.py:66`, `test_completion_token_recovery.py:312`, `test_completion_recovery_context_product_bound.py:94-97`, `test_completion_recovery_oversized_d59e.py:57,220`) stay valid unchanged. Underscore-helper module-alias reads repoint to `completion_criteria`: `_validate_recovery_inputs` (`test_completion_recovery_contract.py`, `test_completion_recovery_context_product_bound.py:112-137`), `_validate_coverage` (`test_completion_recovery_contract.py`, `test_completion_banking.py:219-239`, `test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py:288-296`), `_MAX_TOTAL_CRITERIA_CHARS` (`test_completion_recovery_oversized_d59e.py:190-191`).
Caller updates: `completion.py:758` prelude imports and doc cross-references. Tests get import-path and monkeypatch-target updates ONLY; zero assertion changes.
Riskiest assumption: every moved symbol stays patchable where its runtime caller reads it. Cheapest falsifier, run FIRST per move: grep the moved name as a string across src+tests (monkeypatch/patch/importlib/getattr).

## Scope
Edit: `src/rebar/llm/completion.py`, `src/rebar/llm/epic_bug_screen.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py`. Create: `src/rebar/llm/completion_child_gate.py`, `src/rebar/llm/completion_reconcile.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_criteria.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_failures.py`. Test import/patch-target updates in `tests/unit/test_epic_bug_screen_4b54.py` and the recovery suites that import underscore helpers (`test_completion_recovery_contract.py`, `test_completion_recovery_context_product_bound.py`, `test_completion_recovery_oversized_d59e.py`, `test_completion_banking.py`, `test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py`).

## Testing
Mechanical, behavior-preserving refactor — no new testable behavior; the existing suites are the oracle, unmodified except import paths/patch targets: `pytest tests/unit/workflow tests/unit/test_epic_bug_screen_4b54.py tests/unit/test_ticket_description_limit.py tests/unit/test_close_gate_bound_remedy_db1c.py tests/unit/test_agent_call_runaway_guard_c827.py tests/interfaces`; `make lint` (complexity ratchet must report new=0 increased=0) and `make typecheck`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every touched/created module ends 200-500 LOC (hard: none > 700, none < 100); checked by `wc -l` on the nine modules above.
- [x] Decomposition plan (concern map + module contracts) recorded on this ticket before implementation; checked: this description section + a summarizing ticket comment exist.
- [x] Zero behavior change: the suites named in Testing pass with no assertion edits (import-path/monkeypatch-target updates only); checked by running them green.
- [x] Every moved symbol's dotted name swept as a string across src+tests with no orphaned patch targets; checked: grep for each old dotted path returns only intentionally-kept re-export seams.
- [x] `make lint` + `make typecheck` clean; complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0; module-size check green (all `src/rebar` files ≤ 800).
- [x] Change pushed to Gerrit carrying trailer `rebar-ticket: 45c1-513b-d97a-46d3`; checked by the created change number (submit/close deferred to the operator per instructions).
